svg.title: Aggregated vs PD vs EPD over TCP, multimodal context sweep
svg.desc: Small-multiple line charts comparing 1-GPU aggregated serving, 2-GPU PD and 3-GPU EPD over TCP across concurrency 1, 4 and 8 on 1k, 2k, 4k and 8k multimodal contexts for ITL p99 (ms), TTFT p50 (ms, log scale) and output throughput (tok/s). EPD cuts 4k/8k concurrency-8 ITL p99 by 15.1x to 21.8x (231.453 to 15.352 ms; 296.710 to 13.607 ms), while 1-GPU aggregated keeps the lowest TTFT p50 at every 1k cell and at 8k concurrency 8 (3,963.085 vs 4,182.324 ms).
svg.text: MODEL DEPLOYMENT · EPD BENCHMARK · TCP BASELINE
Aggregated vs PD vs EPD over TCP, multimodal context sweep
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct on one 8 × H100 SXM5 node; unequal GPU budgets (1, 2 and 3 GPUs), 128-token output cap.
Unequal GPU budgets: Aggregated used 1 GPU, PD 2 GPUs, EPD 3 GPUs (TP = 1 per role). Concurrency 1, 4 and 8 used 8, 12 and 24 measured requests.
All 36 Suite 1 cells completed with zero errors. Cross-Pod NIXL encoder-cache and Mooncake KV transfers used TCP over eth0; no RDMA attached.
